sentences.en: TopSage.com Well, most people think that lions only come from Africa.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 嗯，大多数人认为狮子只产自非洲。

sentences.en: And you would be forgiven for thinking this, because in fact most lions do come from Africa.
sentences.zh: 而且你这样想也是情有可原的，因为事实上大多数狮子确实来自非洲。

sentences.en: But this hasn't always been the case.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: If we go back ten thousand years we would find that there were lions roaming vast sections of the globe.
sentences.zh: 如果我们回溯一万年前，就会发现当时狮子曾遍布全球大片区域。

sentences.en: But now, unfortunately, only very small sections of the lions' former habitat remain.
sentences.zh: 但如今，不幸的是，狮子昔日栖息地仅剩极小部分尚存。

sentences.en: My particular interest is Asiatic lions, which arc sub-species of African lions.
sentences.zh: 我特别关注的是亚洲狮，它是非洲狮的一个亚种。

sentences.en: It's almost a hundred thousand years since the Asiatic lions split off and developed as a sub-species.
sentences.zh: 亚洲狮大约在十万年前从非洲狮中分化出来，并逐渐演化为一个独立亚种。

sentences.en: At one time the Asiatic lion was living as far west as Greece and they were found from there, in a band that spread east through various countries of the Middle East, all the way to India.
sentences.zh: 曾经，亚洲狮的分布范围西至希腊，其分布带自希腊向东延伸，贯穿中东各国，一直抵达印度。

sentences.en: In museums, you can now see Greek coins that have clear images of the Asiatic lion on them.
sentences.zh: 如今在博物馆里，你可以看到一些古希腊钱币，上面清晰印有亚洲狮的图案。

sentences.en: Most of them are dated at around 500 B.C.
sentences.zh: 这些钱币大多可追溯至公元前500年左右。

sentences.en: However, Europe saw its last Asiatic lion roaming free two thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 然而，欧洲最后一只野生亚洲狮于两千年前消失。

sentences.en: Over the next nineteen hundred years the numbers of Asiatic lions in the other areas declined steadily, but it was only in the nineteenth century that they disappeared from everywhere but India.
sentences.zh: 在此后的一千九百年间，亚洲狮在其他地区的数量持续减少，直到十九世纪，它们才最终从除印度以外的所有地区彻底消失。

sentences.en: So, how can you tell an Asiatic lion from an African lion, with which you're probably more familiar?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何区分亚洲狮与你可能更为熟悉的非洲狮呢？

sentences.en: Well, in general, Asiatic lions are not as big as African lions.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，亚洲狮体型不如非洲狮庞大。

sentences.en: The colour is more or less the same, but the appearance of the mane is different - that's the hair around the lion's face and neck.
sentences.zh: 毛色大致相同，但鬃毛外观不同——即环绕狮子面部和颈部的毛发。

sentences.en: The Asiatic lion's mane is noticcably shorter than the African lion's.
sentences.zh: 亚洲狮的鬃毛明显比非洲狮更短。

sentences.en: Asiatic lions also have a long fold of skin on their undersides, whereas not many African lions have this.
sentences.zh: 此外，亚洲狮腹部还有一道明显的纵向皮肤褶皱，而多数非洲狮并不具备这一特征。

sentences.en: Well, I'd like to talk to you now about the Gir Sanctuary in India.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向大家介绍一下印度的吉尔野生动物保护区。

sentences.en: That's where I've just come back from.
sentences.zh: 我刚从那里回来。

sentences.en: The sanctuary was established specifically to protect the Asiatic lion.
sentences.zh: 该保护区设立的初衷正是为了保护亚洲狮。

sentences.en: It's 1.450 square kilometres in area and most of it is forest.
sentences.zh: 保护区面积达1450平方公里，其中大部分为森林。

sentences.en: There are now around three hundred Asiatic lions in India and almost all of them are in this sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 目前印度约有三百只亚洲狮，其中几乎全部都生活在这个保护区内。

sentences.en: But despite living in a sanctuary, which makes them safe from hunters, they still face a number of problems that threaten their survival.
sentences.zh: 但尽管生活在保护区中，免受猎人威胁，它们仍面临诸多危及其生存的问题。

sentences.en: One of these is the ever-present danger of disease.
sentences.zh: 其中之一便是始终存在的疾病风险。

sentences.en: This is what killed more than a third of Africa's Serengeti lions in 1994, and people are fearful that something similar could happen in the Gir Sanctuary and kill off many of the Asiatic lions there.
sentences.zh: 1994年，类似疾病曾导致非洲塞伦盖蒂三分之一以上的狮子死亡；人们担心类似事件也可能在吉尔保护区发生，从而大量杀死当地亚洲狮。

sentences.en: India's lions are particularly vulnerable because they have a limited gene pool.
sentences.zh: 印度的狮子尤其脆弱，因为它们的基因库十分有限。

sentences.en: The reason for this is interesting - it's because all of them are descended from a few dozen lions that were saved by a prince who took a particular interest in them.
sentences.zh: 造成这一现象的原因颇为有趣——所有现存亚洲狮均源自数十只曾被一位对它们格外关注的王子所拯救的个体。

sentences.en: He was very wealthy, and he managed to protect them - otherwise they'd probably have died out completely.
sentences.zh: 这位王子非常富有，成功保护了它们；否则，它们很可能已彻底灭绝。

sentences.en: When you see the Asiatic lion in India, what you sense is enormous vitality.
sentences.zh: 当你在印度亲眼见到亚洲狮时，感受到的是一种惊人的旺盛生命力。

sentences.en: They're very impressive beasts and you would never guess that they had this vulnerability when you look at them.
sentences.zh: 它们是极为威武雄壮的猛兽，单凭外表，你绝不会想到它们竟如此脆弱。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts } SA The Asiatic lions don't have the Gir Sanctuary to themselves, I should add.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音原文 } SA 我还需补充一点：亚洲狮并非独享吉尔保护区。

sentences.en: They actually share it with about two thousand farmers.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它们与约两千名农民共同生活于此。

sentences.en: A significant proportion of the lions' diet is 038 com made up of the livestock of these farmers goats, chickens and so on as much as a third, in fact.
sentences.zh: 亚洲狮食谱中相当大一部分（事实上高达三分之一）由这些农民饲养的牲畜构成——如山羊、鸡等。

sentences.en: And they've even been known to attack humans, especially in times of drought.
sentences.zh: 甚至有记录显示它们在干旱时期会袭击人类。

sentences.en: One final piece of interesting information - in ancient India one of the greatest tests of leadership for a man was to fight a lion.
sentences.zh: 最后再分享一则有趣的信息：在古代印度，男子展现领导力的最高考验之一便是徒手搏狮。

sentences.en: Now it seems, in modern India it will be a great test to see if the lion can be saved.
sentences.zh: 如今看来，在现代印度，能否成功拯救狮子，或许将成为另一项重大考验。

sentences.en: I'm sure this is something that all of you will share concern for too.
sentences.zh: 我相信，这一点也定会引起在座各位的共同关切。
